label: EML4::ALK

sections.text: EML4 encodes a microtubule-associated protein with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain.
ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development.
An intrachromosomal inversion joins the EML4 oligomerization region to the ALK kinase domain, producing ligand-independent kinase signaling and an established lung-cancer driver.

ALK-positive metastatic NSCLC is eligible for ALK-directed kinase inhibition; alectinib also has a US adjuvant indication after resection of ALK-positive NSCLC, with the pivotal trial enrolling stage IB tumors at least 4 cm through stage IIIA disease.
